unit: Six freshly content-exposed task-family question templates from the same pinned Reasoning Gym commit; filenames previously listed. Purposive 3 Boolean/3 non-Boolean selection fixed before description/scorer inspection.
user_steering: User initially chose independent human annotation, then asked assistant to complete it. Use AI-assisted researcher reference contracts, never claim real human annotation, measured human time or causal human-effort savings.
conditions: One-shot isolated LLM extraction from description only
Independently authored and reviewed description-only reference contract; AI assisted
information_boundary: Same description and placeholder notes. Extractor receives opaque task ID and generic schema, not task filename, solution, scorer/helper, generator fragments, issues, PRs, reference contract, comparison rubric or baseline output.
reference_boundary: Reference author sees task descriptions and generic schema only. Freeze reference before inspecting model responses and scorer bodies. Cross-review reference against exact wording. This is an assisted reference comparison, not an independent-human experiment.
model_protocol: Six independent fresh ephemeral Codex CLI requests, one per task; fixed prompt/schema; no examples or in-context cross-task outputs. No tools accepted; preserve prompts, raw response, JSONL events, stderr, actual model identity when reported, usage, failure logs and hashes. No outcome-driven prompt retries.
scorer_access: Do not inspect scorer implementations before prompt, reference and model responses are fixed. Afterwards extract source only; no upstream module import or generator execution. Downstream source discovery failures stay Unknown.

contract_comparison.grading: Semantic comparison with independently fixed reference and source-description evidence, not exact natural-language string equality. Preserve per-field keep/add/remove/replace/uncertain decisions and reasons; independently review. Do not reward verbosity or invent unstated scorer policies.
metrics: token usage and model runtime when available
contract_comparison.effort_limit: Field revisions are a review-burden proxy. No human time measurements or proof that LLM reduces human effort. Writing from scratch versus editing is not a randomized human study.

downstream.analyzers: Exactly preserved Semgrep adapter and bounded symbolic code/rules. Only input preparation, conservative contract projection and reporting are new.
downstream.projection: Only existing C_BOOLEAN_FULL necessary-condition projection for native True/False tasks is eligible. Actual generated reference field shape must support its trusted canonical-string assumption. Other task types are unsupported under the frozen interface, not force-fit to probability/complex/palindrome/factorization contracts.
downstream.projection_limits: Checks agreement with trusted Boolean reference, not correctness of string-isomorphism/letter/cycle solving; full formatting and deeper semantics remain outside this projection. Normalization may be weakened only as an explicitly reported necessary condition, never a full-contract correctness claim.
metrics: contract-caused errors versus analyzer coverage limits
downstream.label_limit: No blanket negative labels from absence of findings. TP/FP/FN/TN only if source/witness adjudication under fixed contract supports a label; otherwise report unadjudicated. No synthetic bugs silently counted as real cases.
downstream.gain_limit: Equal contract projections or equal detector verdicts do not show improved detection. Unsupported projections are not evidence of failed extraction or neural necessity.

stopping_rule: One frozen six-task pilot; no task replacement, analyzer expansion, prompt tuning to outputs or new model/function support to improve results.
